adjudication.rationale: In `admin/templates/group.hbs` the members are rendered via `{{each member in members itemView="group-member"}}`, which means the item view/template is driven by the per-item context (the member). In `admin/templates/group_member.hbs`, the conditional `{{#unless automatic}} ... {{/unless}}` is unscoped, so it will resolve against the member context, not the parent group/controller. Since a member object won’t have an `automatic` property, `automatic` will be falsy/undefined and the `unless` block will render, showing the remove link even for automatic groups. Clicking it triggers `removeMember` -> `/admin/groups/:id/members.json` DELETE, which the backend rejects for automatic groups (422 via `can_not_modify_automatic`).
